statement.zh: Cascajal 石板已被定论为中美洲最早文字且释读完成。
statement.en: The Cascajal Block is settled as Mesoamerica’s earliest writing and is fully deciphered.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: Cascajal’s status as writing and any decipherment remain contested in registered sources.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only. Density pass 4 (D-2026-10-12-4); bibliographic details verified via WebSearch/catalog pages 2026-10-12; no invented page numbers/coordinates/forged images.
